source_text.Q-1042: MEDIUM, owner CI lane (follow-up of Q-1037, the next lever after sharding). Reported by the supervisor 2026-10-08. Evidence: ExUnit reports ~0.5 s average per test and ~66 min of cumulative test work per backend run (7.7k tests); a large share is believed to be the per-test tenant schema clone from tenant_template (CREATE SCHEMA ... LIKE tenant_template... for every table, see the LETFLOW_TENANT_FIXTURE setup/teardown log lines and the 'tenant_template_build' schemas): cost per test = DDL for every table of the template plus DROP SCHEMA CASCADE at teardown. NOT yet measured: step 1 is to instrument (time per clone, number of tables cloned, share of test time) on one partition, step 2 choose the lever: (a) clone only the tables the test needs, (b) share a read-only tenant across tests that do not mutate it (async-safe), (c) a pooled tenant per module with truncate-reset, (d) Postgres schema cloning via CREATE DATABASE ... TEMPLATE or a faster mechanism; keep isolation guarantees (no cross-test leakage, the ISS-0410-class isolation bugs). Each step measured before/after; mutation proof that isolation still holds (a test that leaves data behind must not leak into the next). Overlap check 2026-10-08: Q-1037 is the umbrella; ISS-0410 (isolation failure, blocked) is background, not a duplicate.

issues.description: INV-7 shape: new raw SQL in test/support/tenant_fixture.ex and tenant_template.ex interpolates identifiers (DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS, TRUNCATE, ALTER SEQUENCE, INSERT..SELECT, DELETE/UPDATE public.<table>). Every identifier is wrapped by ident/1 or quote_ident/1 (embedded-quote doubling) and quote_literal/1 for literals; values (tenant_id, dumped JSON, schema_name in probes) go through $n binds. Sources of names: slot schema names generated by the fixture/provisioning, table/column/sequence names read from pg_catalog (discover_public, baseline), template schema is a module constant. No name originates from outside the catalog or fixture. Acceptable; no action.

No explicit runtime guard that DDL (DROP SCHEMA ... CASCADE, TRUNCATE) only runs against a test database. Protection is structural: modules are compiled only under MIX_ENV=test via elixirc_paths, and config/test.exs hard-codes database "letflow_test<MIX_TEST_PARTITION>" on localhost. Same posture as the pre-existing fixture teardown (DROP SCHEMA CASCADE). Residual risk: someone running MIX_ENV=test with a DB override env pointing at a shared DB; not introduced by this diff. Optional hardening: assert current_database() starts with 'letflow_test' in start_pool!/2. Not a blocker.

Logging: fixture emits LETFLOW_TENANT_FIXTURE lines with schema names, tenant ids, pg backend pids and left(query,300) of straggler backends (describe_busy). Query text of foreign backends in a test DB could in principle contain test-fixture literals but no production secrets; no tokens/credentials are written by the fixture. ISS-1042.yaml measurements contain only timings and counts.

Isolation assertions not weakened: git diff of identity_id_hardening_test.exs, promotion_scope_test.exs, definitions/store_test.exs is additions only (20/20/22 lines: setup_all start_pool!, first setup attach_pool!, audit comments); zero assertion lines removed or edited. Cross-tenant tests acquire distinct slots (declared scope-a/b/p; store_test two slots of the same shape; claim_pooled! keys {shape,k} with k incremented per same-shape call, so two tenants in one test are never the same schema). Pool is fail-closed: fence A / final guard raise, async modules rejected, undeclared shape raises, drift triggers rebuild. Residual theoretical masking: a leak test relying on a tenant that was reset instead of freshly cloned would still see separate schemas, so no cross-tenant masking path found. The pool_leak/mutation proof (M1..M22) is TEST-DESIGNER/TEST-RUNNER scope.
